title: Escalations from a2dlc check (.a2dlc/escalations.json, not committed) and from a2dlc run (.a2dlc/run/<slice>/escalations.json, run artifact)
description: schema_version 1. What the engines and the test gates emit (check) and the a2dlc run stages emit (1, 1.5, 4 with N=2, 5, 6 and 7); check never emits the run kinds. "v2" marks optional fields added (cluster_id and builder), not a change of schema_version. It is what a person has to decide, or what the tool could not decide, in a form that an orchestrator or a UI consumes without reading the verdict (ADR meta/0004, boundary with the LLM roles). The decision comes back as a waiver in .a2dlc/waivers.json and is approved with a signature; the decisions that can be taken go in resolve_with. It is outside the tree_hash.

tree_hash.description: The tree judged. With N=2 (items with builder), the one from the verdict in verdict.json: the selected one, the worst if none passed, or the primary if it escalated by CB-01.

id.description: sha256 of kind + target, stable across runs.

kind.description: behavior_divergence: an engine found a difference, or a test of T fails on the candidate and passes on another tree (protocol CB-01 / bug-or-feature probe), or a test from the Saboteur's overlay fails on the candidate without any other tree running it (new symbol: the spec the test reads and the candidate's differ; NOP/Oracle gives FAIL and tests_diff INCONCLUSIVE "red only in the candidate"). test_without_teeth: a new test (from the candidate or the overlay) passes on the base with stubs against a change that declares intent to change behavior, or fails on every tree that ran it (it discriminates nothing). flaky_test: flaky on the base, or flaky on the candidate in tests_diff. uncovered_change: changed lines that no engine examined and no test ran; the verdict cannot be PASS until someone brings a test (needs). tooling: INCONCLUSIVE, a tooling problem, not a behavior one. signature_pending: a waiver awaits a signature. mutant_survived (a2dlc run, Stage 5): a mutant of a changed line survived T and the kill gate did not reach the threshold; it asks the Saboteur for a test that kills it (needs), with evidence.mutant. spec_divergence (a2dlc run, Stage 1, CB-01 of §7 in its specification variant): S_α and S_β diverge on a point the Inquisitor did not resolve after --max-spec-rounds; target is <slice>::<topic>, evidence.message says what each specifier asserts, and a person answers it (multiple-choice probe), not a waiver. backtranslation_mismatch (a2dlc run, Stage 1.5, §5 step 5): the blind back-translation of S* does not say what the intent says; target is <slice>::<clause> and evidence.message says what the intent says and what S* implies. The contract or the translation may be wrong: a person decides. unsat_spec (a2dlc run, Stage 1.5, CB-02a of §7): Z3 says the smt clauses of a function have no input that satisfies them; target is <slice>::<function> and evidence.message carries the unsat core: the clauses are relaxed and it runs again. consumer_broken (a2dlc run, Stage 6, consumer-driven contract matrix): the suite of a consumer declared in config.integration fails against the candidate; target is <consumer>::<test> and evidence.message carries the failure. destructive_migration (a2dlc run, Stage 6, expand-and-contract): a changed migration file contains destructive DDL (DROP COLUMN/TABLE, RENAME, in-place type change, TRUNCATE); target is <file>::L<line> and evidence.message the statement; it is rewritten as expand → backfill → contract. missing_compensation (a2dlc run, Stage 7, CB-06): the slice declares writes (intent.delivery.writes) without a compensation strategy; target is <slice>::delivery; the plan stays at max_ring 1 until the intent declares it. protected_boundary (a2dlc run, Stage 3, CB-04 of §7 in its boundary variant): the builder touched intent.boundary; target is <file>::<glob> if the file matches forbidden_paths, or <file>::<symbol> if a changed line contains a do_not_refactor symbol (textual heuristic: it also flags a new call site). evidence.message carries the first differing line; escalating privileges is a decision for a person with a signed waiver, not for the builder. builder_exhaustion (a2dlc run, Stage 3, CB-02b of §7): a builder exhausted max_inner_iterations without a green Tier 0, and the tier_up of roles.json (if it declares one) too; target is <slice>::builder and evidence.message carries the last Tier 0 finding. Splitting the slice is a person's decision: it is not resolved with a waiver (resolve_with empty). prerequisite_failure (a2dlc run, Stage −1, CB-05 of §7): the baseline could not be established on the base with tests.baseline_command in the network-less sandbox (no JUnit, no testcases, red without an identifiable test, image or command down, timeout); target is <slice>::baseline and evidence.message the reason. Intervention in Stage −1 (fix the command, image or suite): no waiver resolves it (resolve_with empty). Pre-existing reds are not CB-05: they stay in the baseline and Stage 4 compares against them. protected_path (a2dlc check, config.protected_paths): a changed file matches a protected glob and has no valid signed approval; target is <file>::<glob>, evidence.message says which glob. dependency_not_allowed (config.supply_chain): a manifest adds or changes a dependency that the allowlist file does not list; target is <file>::<ecosystem>/<name>, evidence.message the manifest line. lemma_failed (a2dlc run, Stage 2, lemmas of a Critical slice): a declared postcondition of a pure internal function fails; target is <slice>::<lemma>, evidence.counterexample the failing input and evidence.message the failure; it goes back to the builder as Tier 0 feedback. trace_coverage_low (config.tests.trace_coverage): the branch coverage of the recorded traces is below min_branch or was not measured; target is <slice>::traces, evidence.message names the field. check_failed (config.checks, protocol §5 Checks): a blocking pluggable check reported a finding with no signed accept_finding waiver; target is the finding's (<file>::<check id> or <file>::L<line>), evidence.message the finding's message. A blocking check in error or timeout is tooling (target .a2dlc/config.json::checks.<check id>, resolve_with empty): it cannot be waived into a PASS.

evidence.description: Minimal counterexample, test states (per tree in tests_diff) or uncovered lines, depending on kind.

lines.description: uncovered_change: changed lines of the file (in the candidate) that nobody examined.

mutant.description: mutant_survived: the live mutant. Without the candidate's code: it is what the Saboteur sees.

resolve_with.description: Waiver decisions that resolve the escalation. Empty: a person cannot resolve it with a waiver (tooling, uncovered_change) or it is already declared (signature_pending: resolved with a2dlc approve).

needs.description: What an outside role (LLM or person) must bring to resolve it. uncovered_change asks the Saboteur (§3: writes tests against the public signatures and the contract, without seeing the code) for tests that run the lines; a2dlc run passes them with --tests-overlay. The Inquisitor is kept for what arises from the contract (probes), not from coverage.

cluster_id.description: v2, optional: kind plus the normalized message (contract.ClusterID), an approximation of a root cause (§7, escalation hygiene). clu- plus the first 12 hex digits of the sha256 of kind, a NUL byte and the normalized message: evidence.message if there is one, otherwise summary, lowercased, each run of digits replaced by #, spaces collapsed. The target is not part of the key: the same kind and message across targets is one cluster. Escalations with the same cluster_id are decided together.

builder.description: v2, optional: with N=2 (a2dlc run), which candidate the escalation comes from. The run's escalations.json combines those of both.

answer_id.description: v2, optional: the probe id a person answered, when this escalation was resolved from answers.json (answers.schema.json).
